# Pre-Implement Checklist: PicPay Simplificado — Transferências

**Purpose**: Validar qualidade dos requisitos antes de `/speckit.implement` — cobre completude, clareza, consistência e rastreabilidade de spec/plan/tasks para implementação segura
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are document validation requirements for CPF `^[0-9]{11}$` and CNPJ `^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$` (IN 2.229/2024) documented with format, normalization and DV rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020/§FR-021]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements for `DocumentConsumer` vs `DocumentMerchant` factory by `UserType` documented as domain intent rather than BR infra terms? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, tasks.md T022-T024]
- [ ] CHK003 Are DomainException hierarchy requirements documented with `businessCode` for metrics/OTEL/event_tracking per bounded context (User/Wallet/Transfer)? [Completeness, tasks.md T008, Constitution VI:164]
- [ ] CHK004 Are financial invariant requirements (no negative balance, atomic debit/credit, deterministic wallet locks) documented as MUST? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Constitution III:62]
- [ ] CHK005 Are idempotency requirements (internal hash `payer+payee+value` Redis TTL 3m, false-positive risk) documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, research.md Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK006 Are Outbox notification requirements documented with transactional insert + async retry ≤3 + backoff? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, plan.md:149]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is `hash seguro` quantified with specific algorithm `PASSWORD_ARGON2ID` (64MiB/4/1) fallback `BCRYPT cost12`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, research.md Decision 10]
- [ ] CHK008 Is `available_at` backoff quantified with specific intervals `10s→60s→300s` and `lease_until 30s`? [Clarity, plan.md:149]
- [ ] CHK009 Is `merchant cannot pay` clarified with `businessCode=merchant_payer_blocked` and `403` mapping? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, tasks.md T046]
- [ ] CHK010 Is `value` string pattern `^(?!0+\.00$)[0-9]+\.[0-9]{2}$` defined as positive with exactly 2 decimals rejecting `number`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, contracts/transfer.yaml:75]
- [ ] CHK011 Is CNPJ legacy compatibility `^[0-9]{14}$` subset of `^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$` explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Edge Cases]
